title: BTS Wraps North American 'Arirang' Leg With 1.92 Million Fans, Sets SoFi Stadium Record
detail: September 8, 2026 — Korean outlets published a full recap confirming the ARIRANG World Tour's North American leg — 31 sold-out shows across 12 cities in Canada, Mexico and the United States from April 25 through Sept 6 — drew approximately 1.92 million fans in total. The four-show Los Angeles stand at SoFi Stadium alone drew about 282,000 attendees; combined with BTS's four 2021 'Permission to Dance on Stage' shows at the venue, the group has now played eight concerts there, more than any other act, for a cumulative 496,000 fans — the highest total ever recorded at the stadium since it opened. The four LA shows also live-streamed globally via Weverse to 177 regions. The Los Angeles Times noted the run 'convincingly framed BTS as a world-class pop act.' The tour resumes Oct 2 in Bogotá, Colombia — BTS's first full-group visit to Colombia, Peru and Argentina.

media.caption: BTS wraps the ARIRANG World Tour's North American leg with a SoFi Stadium attendance record.

title: RM Shares Viral Photo of Son Heung-Min with V and Jungkook Backstage
detail: September 8, 2026 — RM posted a photo to his personal social media of footballer Son Heung-min posing backstage with V and Jungkook, taken after Son attended BTS's Sept 2 SoFi Stadium show as an audience guest and was shown on the venue's video board flashing his signature 'frame' celebration pose. The image, shared as BTS wrapped the ARIRANG World Tour's North American leg, immediately went viral; Son has been friends with V for years and previously called BTS 'national heroes,' while Jimin had worn a Son-numbered jersey during the FIFA World Cup Final halftime show that later sold at auction for $110,000.

media.caption: Son Heung-min poses with BTS's V and Jungkook in a photo RM shared publicly.
